scientific_integrity: A complete proof and executable exhaustive checks for small finite fields are included; the general statement relies on the written proof, not computation.
scientific_limitations: Rank-one square-zero matrices only; no classification of individual commutator fibers, no full matrix-pair conjugacy classification, and publication-priority comparison remains non-exhaustive.
title: Exact commutator and Lie-generation spectra of rank-one nilpotent matrices
